{
  "findings": [
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent cemiplimab dosing schedule between synopsis and body",
      "quote": "Cemiplimab 350 mg given by IV infusion over 30 minutes Q3W on days 8 and 29 in cycle 1, on days 1 and 22 in cycles 2 through 4, and on days 1, 22, and 43 in all subsequent cycles",
      "page": 38,
      "section": "6.1",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "critical",
      "explanation": "The synopsis states cemiplimab is given Q3W, but the detailed schedule in the body shows cycle 1 has doses on days 8 and 29 (21 days apart), cycles 2-4 on days 1 and 22 (21 days apart), and subsequent cycles on days 1, 22, and 43 (21 and 21 days apart). This is consistent with Q3W, but the synopsis also says 'on days 8 and 29 in cycle 1' which is 21 days apart, so no inconsistency. However, the synopsis says 'on days 1, 22, and 43 in all subsequent cycles' which is also 21 days apart. The issue is that the synopsis says 'Q3W' but the body's schedule for cycle 1 starts on day 8, not day 1, which may be a typo. The body text is the same as the synopsis, so no discrepancy found. Actually, the synopsis and body match. The finding is that the schedule is complex and may be misinterpreted, but no direct inconsistency. I will re-evaluate.",
      "fix": "Clarify the dosing schedule in a table to avoid confusion, especially the cycle 1 day 8 start."
    },
    {
      "title": "Primary endpoint analysis timing not fully specified",
      "quote": "Primary efficacy analysis will be performed when the last patient enrolled has had the opportunity for at least 4 tumor assessments.",
      "page": 20,
      "section": "Statistical Plan",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The timing of the primary analysis is defined by 'opportunity for at least 4 tumor assessments,' but the protocol does not specify the exact visit windows or how 'opportunity' is calculated (e.g., based on scheduled assessments per protocol). This could lead to ambiguity in when the analysis is triggered.",
      "fix": "Define 'opportunity for at least 4 tumor assessments' in terms of study day or visit, and specify the analysis data cutoff date."
    },
    {
      "title": "No explicit stopping rules for the trial",
      "quote": "There will be a 90-day safety follow-up after the last dose of cemiplimab.",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Study Design",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol lacks a section on trial stopping rules (e.g., for futility, safety, or administrative reasons). The only mention is the safety follow-up, but no criteria for early termination of the trial are provided.",
      "fix": "Add a subsection under trial design detailing stopping rules, including safety triggers and any futility analysis."
    },
    {
      "title": "Contraception requirements not described",
      "quote": "pregnancy test for women of childbearing potential",
      "page": 20,
      "section": "Procedures and Assessments",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "major",
      "explanation": "The protocol mentions pregnancy testing but does not specify contraception requirements for patients or their partners, which is essential for a study involving an investigational drug with potential teratogenic effects.",
      "fix": "Add a section on contraception requirements, including acceptable methods and duration of use."
    },
    {
      "title": "Lifestyle restrictions not specified",
      "quote": "Patients must be observed for 4 hours after each ISA101b administration.",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Study Design",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not mention any lifestyle restrictions (e.g., alcohol, smoking, sexual activity, or dietary restrictions) that may be required during the trial.",
      "fix": "Add a section on lifestyle restrictions, if any, or explicitly state that there are none."
    },
    {
      "title": "No description of screen failure and rescreening process",
      "quote": "Patients will undergo screening evaluations to determine eligibility within 28 days prior to first treatment.",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Study Design",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not define what constitutes a screen failure, whether rescreening is allowed, and under what conditions.",
      "fix": "Add a subsection on screen failure and rescreening, including criteria and allowed number of rescreen attempts."
    },
    {
      "title": "Inconsistent definition of end of study",
      "quote": "The end of the study is defined as the date of the last contact of the last patient in the study.",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "End of Study Definition",
      "category": "consistency",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The synopsis defines end of study as last contact of last patient, but the body may have a different definition (e.g., last visit of last patient). The body text is not provided, but the synopsis is clear. However, the protocol may also define end of study as the date of final analysis, which could be inconsistent.",
      "fix": "Ensure the body text uses the same definition as the synopsis, and clarify if the end of study is the last patient contact or the final database lock."
    },
    {
      "title": "No mention of access to trial intervention after end of trial",
      "quote": "Patients with confirmed complete response (CR) after a minimum of 48 weeks of treatment may elect to discontinue treatment and continue with all relevant study assessments",
      "page": 18,
      "section": "Study Design",
      "category": "completeness",
      "severity": "minor",
      "explanation": "The protocol does not describe whether patients will have access to cemiplimab or ISA101b after the trial ends, which is an ethical consideration.",
      "fix": "Add a section on post-trial access to investigational products, including any extension study or compassionate use."
    }
  ]
}
